title: UAPI: crypto2dev_kdf_op struct and CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_DO_KDF
description:
Add to include/uapi/crypto2dev_ioctl.h:
- #define CRYPTO2DEV_KDF_SALT_MAXLEN  64
- #define CRYPTO2DEV_KDF_INFO_MAXLEN  256
- struct crypto2dev_kdf_op with fields per design issue
- CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_DO_KDF = _IOWR(CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_MAGIC, 20, struct crypto2dev_kdf_op)
- Full field-by-field comment block explaining HKDF vs PBKDF2 inputs
- Document that fd becomes a KEY fd on success; write() data is consumed and zeroized
- Document PBKDF2 iterations minimum (1000) and recommended minimum (600000 per OWASP 2023)
notes: Struct restored with out_algo[CRYPTO2DEV_ALGO_MAXLEN] added per WOLFKM-nid design. Slot 22 is live; dispatch returns -ENOSYS until providers implement kdf callback.
